content:
Hello,

A bit over a month ago, I submitted a PR with some performance improvements for incremental command elaboration, but it has not been reviewed yet. Per the pull request policy, I marked it as a draft because there is no corresponding GitHub issue, but I wonder if that is causing it to not show up in people's review queues? I cannot manually request a review either, again because it is marked as a draft. I am wondering how to proceed? Should I just mark it as not a draft? Thank you

If you mark your PR as draft that specifically means it's not supposed to get merged yet (e.g. because you're still working on it or just experimenting) and is thus not going to get reviewed. Some changes don't need issues though, like such performance improvement. So, if you're think it's ready to review, mark it as ready to review (i.e. undraft)
(lean4#15178, right?)
Yes that's the PR, I meant to link it. That makes sense, I just wanted to be sure I wasn't breaking the PR policy. Thanks!
